title_zh: AI 编程可信度危机与定价获客
title_en: AI Coding Reliability Crisis & Pricing as Growth
desc_zh: AI 编程从「万能」到「不可靠」的共识正在形成；取消免费试用+翻倍定价 23 天做到 $1,600 MRR；合规成本上升为隐性威胁。
desc_en: Consensus forms that AI coding is 'unreliable'; removing free trial + doubling price hit $1,600 MRR in 23 days; compliance costs rise as hidden threat.
